sn42.2:1.8: “Sir, I have heard that the dancers of the past who were tutors of tutors said:
sn42.2:1.9: ‘Suppose a dancer entertains and amuses people on a stage or at a festival with mixed truth and lies. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in the company of laughing gods.’
sn42.2:1.11: “Enough, chief, let it be. Don’t ask me that.”
